sections.title: Fixes
items: Resizing the Wrapper could lock it up (Not Responding, tray menu dead, force close needed). Two parts of Toasted were waiting on each other; they no longer can.
The Wrapper could be made shorter than Roon's own minimum, leaving Roon hanging out below the player bar. It now stops at a size that fits Roon.
After a PC restart the zone could show as not ready (play greyed out, Fixed volume, 0:00) until Roon's next change. Zone updates from Roon that carry several changes at once are now read in full.

sections.title: Good to know
items: The Wrapper can go down to about 760 px wide now (Roon folds its sidebar away below about 1400, the hamburger button brings it back). The player bar's seek and volume bars shorten to fit; text, icons and art stay the same.

sections.title: What's new
items: The Roon app inside a Toasted window, with Toasted's player along the bottom, so everything Roon can do is right there. Switch it on in Settings > The Wrapper, then open it from the tray (double-click opens it while it's on), its hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+W) or Settings. Closing it keeps Roon running out of sight, so it reopens instantly.
Gives Roon its own window back. An Enable Wrapper button then sits in Roon's title bar to wrap it up again.
Click the album art in the player bar for a full-window player. Hit the pencil to move and resize the art, track info, controls, seek bar, zone, quality light and volume anywhere you like.

Fonts per piece (bundled or any installed font), icon packs (Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler, Material Symbols, Remix), a plain or circled play button, and bar styles for seek and volume: Line, Thick, Hairline, Segments, Wave, Spectrum, Beam, Glow line, LED meter, Ribbon, Neon tube, Mountains, Particles, Plasma and Album art. Bars can take the app's colors, the album's, or your own. The player bar can follow the same style. With Hearts & Library on, the seek bar can show a local file's real waveform from Roon instead (Waveform: Roon, Pills, Solid shape, Neon outline, LED or Album art, optionally Alive (bouncing gently near the playhead) and colored by loudness), falling back to the bar style when Roon has none.
Save your layouts as profiles and switch between them. Start from the Default, Waves or Waves Large presets.
Only want the Wrapper? Switch the Toaster off in Settings > Toaster, or from the tray. Its hotkeys, links, and toast and widget clicks then open the Wrapper instead.

With Hearts & Library on, a small light shows what's playing as Roon receives it: Low Quality, CD Quality or Hi-Res. Hover it for the name. It sits by the zone in the Wrapper's player bar and the Toaster, and is a piece of its own in Now Playing, where it can also show the file's format next to it (like FLAC 96kHz 24bit 2ch).
With the Wrapper on, the Search hotkey and Stream Deck search can open Roon's own search instead of the Toaster's. Pick Roon or Toaster next to the Search hotkey in Settings > General.
A new Toasted icon in the tray, the taskbar and every title bar, and a Roon: Wrapped logo of its own for the Wrapper.
This window. It opens after each update, and the Changelog button in Settings > Updates brings it back. New settings glow until you hover over them.

sections.title: Good to know
items: The tray menu has Toaster, Wrapper and Taskbar Widget switches. While the Wrapper is on, Open Wrapper comes first and a double-click opens it.
Settings > The Wrapper: Now Playing comes back as you left it, open or closed, even after a restart. Something Roon itself doesn't do.
Settings > The Wrapper and Settings > Toaster: open either one whenever Toasted starts, at sign-in or by hand. On for the Wrapper to begin with.
The Wrapper opens where and at the size you left it (maximized excepted).

Some tracks list a long line of supporting artists. Settings > General > Artists: Main shows just the first one Roon lists, in the Toaster, the Wrapper, toasts, the widget and the queue. On to begin with; All brings the full list back.

A new General card holds what applies to the whole app: Colors, Auto-Hide, Start with Windows and every hotkey. The Hotkeys switch sits on the Hotkeys heading, and the Toaster, Wrapper and Taskbar Widget switches sit next to their titles.
Toasted now looks for an update 10 seconds after it starts (it was a minute), and again when you open Settings if the last look is over 10 minutes old.

sections.title: Fixes
items: On PCs with virtual or VPN network adapters (WSL, Docker, Hyper-V, Tailscale), Toasted could miss the Core until a reboot. It now searches on every network adapter and asks the Core's last known address directly.

sections.title: What's new
items: Settings > Roon Core > Manual: type your Core's IP (and port, if you changed it in Roon) for networks where the search can't get through.
Search looks for Cores again right away. Diagnostics shows what the search sees, with a Copy button for bug reports.

sections.title: What's new
items: Heart the playing track, or add it (or its whole album) to your library, right from the Playing tab.
Albums by the playing artist open in the Toaster, and artist pages split Albums from Singles & EPs.
Toasted checks for new versions and installs them with one click.

sections.title: First release
items: A Roon companion for Windows: now playing, queue, browse and search, now-playing toasts, global hotkeys and a taskbar widget.
